- [RARC.13.6] **Same-tier emit-and-match is legal.** A rule at
  tier T may `emit X`; another rule at tier T may
  match `X`. Normal Rete behaviour — emit asserts into
  the tier's working memory; the matcher sees it.
  Refraction keeps one activation from firing again until
  its LHS changes ([LDET.5.3], [LCYC.1.8]).
